messages:
maria: Quick milestone pulse — target to flip on autoscale + egress routing for syd2 by Mon 03/30. Owners: please confirm by EOD Fri the three blockers: (A) routing policy PR merged, (B) residency endpoints + TTLs posted for attestation, (C) infra quota + autoscale chart approved. If any of these miss signoff we push the cutover.

jonathan: Taking routing. PR here: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4891 — adds route priorities, explicit nl-west fallback, and a new egress ACL set. Ping @lee for review.

lee: Reviewing now. Found two ordering quirks on priority rules and one missing unit test for fallback. Will post inline comments and push a tiny fix branch.

sam: Autoscale chart is in branch charts/autoscale-syd2. Helm snippet: ```replicaCount: 2
minReplicas: 1
maxReplicas: 30
metrics:
  - type: Resource
    resource: cpu
``` Also added node-pool sizing notes (gpu-medium). Filed quota bump request QRT-124: worker-gpu-small 12->24.

iris: Legal note — DPA addendum done. We still need explicit network endpoints + retention TTLs for the Sydney region to close the residency attestation. Maria, can you publish the flow + TTL table tomorrow morning?

infra-sre: Created INF-920 to track endpoints/retention + KMS key policy change. Blocker: the KMS key family for syd2 requires an IAM grant so the infra-autoscaler SA can unwrap keys. Need security approval.

toby: Security here — I can approve KMS policy updates. Send me the SA email + purpose and I'll schedule the IAM change. If provided today I can apply Tue morning and record in the change log.

deploy-bot: CI status for infra/pr-4891: unit ✅, integration ✅, e2e ❌ (egress check timed out 504). CI logs: https://ci.redwood/reports/4891 (egress step).

jonathan: Reproducing e2e locally now. My hunch is NAT or new iptables rule on the proxy blocking outbound to the routing-check endpoint. Anyone touched VPC egress rules in the last 48h?

lee: I backported a tighter egress rule to staging yesterday (staging-only). Rolling that change back to validate — will report in 30m.

jonathan: Local e2e repro shows 504 → NAT blocked outbound. Lee's rollback to staging fixed the e2e. Retest queued.

sam: Quota request QRT-124 submitted and asked cloud for expedited review. ETA EOD Thu. If approved we'll bump nodepool and roll autoscale.

maria: I'll export the network flow diagram + TTL table tomorrow AM and attach to INF-920. Also listing where logs/metrics are routed (stack name + bucket).

toby: Ack. Provide SA email and justification and I'll queue the KMS IAM change. ETA Tue apply unless escalated.

lee: Posted PR fixes (ordering + unit test). CI retest started. ETA 1h for green.

jonathan: CI retest passed integration and unit, e2e re-run in progress. If e2e green + quota approved + KMS queued + legal TTLs posted by EOD Fri, we hold Mon cutover. Otherwise we shift one sprint.

maria: Thanks everyone — ping here with short acks/ETAs: @jonathan (routing), @sam (quota), @toby (KMS), @iris (legal). Short replies only please so we can keep statusboard updated. :thumbsup:
